name: Raising Your Children
overview: Scripture teaches that raising children is a sacred responsibility entrusted by the Lord, who calls parents to lead their households in His ways, promoting justice and obedience as exemplified in Abraham's family (Genesis 18:19). Children are described as a heritage and reward from God (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing their value and the need for godly instruction. Parents are urged to diligently teach and discipline their children with love and firmness, as shown in Proverbs where honoring parental guidance and timely correction are essential for wisdom and prudence (Proverbs 1:8; 13:24; 15:5). The commands of God are to be deeply treasured in the heart, shaping the foundation for raising children in the fear of the Lord (Deuteronomy 6:6).
